visualBrief: Norbulingka’s New Summer Palace, with saffron screens and a gilded canopy, the central palace ranges and the lake pavilion with a green hipped roof.

references.role: New Summer Palace symmetrical frontage, gilt canopy, red eaves and saffron screens
New Summer Palace entrance, cloth and roof ornaments
Lake pavilion, pale bridge balustrade, ruby walls and green metal roof
Old Summer Palace entry valance and gilded eaves

limitations: Exterior reconstruction of the New Summer Palace, the lake pavilion and representative mapped palace and garden ranges. The map keeps the wider garden, paths, and pools.

The island platform and short causeway follow the PMTiles lake and island outline. The small roof ornaments, cloth motifs and western and central ranges are interpreted from photographs and the map; their internal rooms are outside this model.
Standard Terrarium provides ground fit. The lake surface and connecting threshold depend on host terrain and water data.
